review_scope: Independent static code review plus targeted synthetic evidence-validator counterexamples. No physical execution performed by this review.
line_reference_policy: Line numbers refer to inspected revision; use hashes/anchors because owners may edit concurrently.

static_positive_observations.limit: Static inspection, not a runtime forbidden-write interception audit.

static_positive_observations.finding: Narrow waist range modifies planner IK only, restored after solve; not a physical simulator joint lock.
static_positive_observations.limit: No claim that arbitrary future controller code preserves this behavior.

ActuatorIntervalAudit.sample called after every physics step; recorder validates 43 finite q/velocity/actual control-force readings and retains extrema.
static_positive_observations.limit: Verifier currently validates only aggregate ratios/count; raw numeric provenance and bounds need stronger binding.

static_positive_observations.finding: 5 kg vs 2 kg distinction is explicitly a public lifted-payload rule; ground supported pushing allowed, physical inability to lift is not claimed.

findings.title: Trajectory records reference torque instead of exact issued substep command
findings.details: Four physics steps apply velocity-dependent clipped leg torques; command_rows stores the unclipped tau_qp once per control interval. This cannot support exact action replay or exact applied-command provenance.
findings.recommended_action: Record each physics substep control mode, clipped force/position command and active ranges; label existing v1 log as references. The owner acknowledged and intends a new attempt.
findings.resolution: Physics commands now record 81 columns for every substep: time, leg mode, 43 actual position targets, 12 clipped leg forces, lower/upper ranges. Runtime archive not yet available; independent replay still pending.

findings.title: Mixed-time measured state row
findings.details: Box position/linear velocity and base states are captured before four scene.step calls; box angular velocity is fetched afterward, then all fields are labeled time=t.
findings.recommended_action: Capture angular velocity alongside other pre-step states or record a unified post-step state with matching timestamp. Treat existing v1 attempt as diagnostic until provenance reviewed.
findings.resolution: Box angular velocity captured with pre-step state; no mixed timestamp fetch in emitted row.

findings.title: Expert phase completion is a hidden success requirement
findings.details: The verifier requires result.status=plan_completed even if complete legal physical delivery already occurred. This contradicts accepting every legal complete route.
findings.recommended_action: Separate recording completeness/integrity from controller sequence completion; decide physical task_success from the goal and public constraints.
findings.resolution: Controller status retained diagnostic, removed from goal success predicate. Synthetic alternative goal accepted.

findings.title: Net grouped contact forces do not establish release
findings.details: contact_summary in solution/underhand_lift/run_underhand.py sums vectors per hand group. Opposing contacts can cancel although the target is still grasped.
findings.recommended_action: Use raw contact magnitude/count and contact identity with declared noise tolerance; do not use only group net force to establish no hand contact.
findings.resolution: Release requires empty contact_links in addition to net forces; synthetic cancelled contact negative rejected.

findings.title: Frozen target/controller profile not fully forwarded or checked
findings.details: CLI forwards mass but leaves target size/friction/x and controller max_push at defaults. They coincide for the current profile, but later profile edits can produce mismatched physics while the verifier uses the claimed profile.
findings.recommended_action: Pass all frozen geometry/physics/controller values explicitly, validate supported initial coordinates, compare result/config/effective model to frozen profile before assigning witness status.
findings.resolution: Profile size/friction/x/max-push forwarded; result geometry/mass/friction and initial position checked. Frozen profile y=0 and z=height/2 match constructor; arbitrary y/z profiles not supported.

findings.title: Missing command, state shape and runtime-integrity validation
findings.details: Independent synthetic fixtures showed acceptance of NaN joint_position_target, a one-column joint array, runtime_pose_writes=true and result mass/size disagreeing with profile. These are software counterexamples, not GPU observations.
findings.recommended_action: Validate finite actual command vectors and expected joint ordering/dimensions; reject forbidden runtime writes/attachments/root wrench; bind effective geometry/mass and required integrity artifacts.
findings.resolution: Finite43 command and50 qpos checks, forbidden integrity flags and scene identity checks added. Four original negative cases now rejected. Flags remain declarations validated with source review, not intercepted runtime calls.

findings.title: Snapshot excludes trusted actuator recorder and plan
findings.details: The source snapshot includes solution/extension plus three environment files but excludes sandbox/trusted/statelog.py imported for actuator/contact logging; expert-plan.json is also not copied by the *.py loop.
findings.recommended_action: Include imported trusted recorder and transitive implementation dependencies plus predeclared expert plan. Record verifier source identity actually used for the result.
findings.resolution: Snapshot includes task trusted recorder, infra/sandbox sources, sonic.json and predeclared expert plan; subprocess executes frozen root. Await actual file/hash verification.

findings.title: Asset identity collected before scene asset generation
findings.details: Asset hashes are collected before collider_mjcf is invoked by environment build; generated or mutated cabinet collision geometry may differ from the pre-build asset inventory.
findings.recommended_action: Record effective post-build recursive asset manifest and compare expected/frozen identities; retain any generated asset sources.
findings.resolution: Cabinet colliders materialized before hashing; assets copied independently and effective final hashes collected. Await runtime pre/post comparison.

findings.title: Verifier does not require hardware/asset/attempt evidence
findings.details: verify reads profile/result/logs/source_hashes but does not require or validate environment.json, asset_hashes.json, attempt.json or a recorded CUDA device. Missing files are silently omitted from the final manifest.
findings.recommended_action: Require mandatory runtime, hardware, source and asset provenance before a Gamma physical witness claim; separate video/replay/publication gates from physical-goal scoring.
findings.resolution: Verifier now requires environment/attempt/frozen execution identity and equal nonempty asset manifests; video review/release gates explicit. Remaining requested checks: key source entries, actual archived asset hashes, exact-command column schema/ranges and world_params required validation.

findings.title: Terminal body collision measurement inherited from previous state
findings.details: terminal row copies rows[-1] and replaces forces/contact links but not body_contact_N; final body-target collision value can be stale.
findings.recommended_action: Recompute all terminal derived fields from the same final contact sample.
findings.resolution: Terminal body_contact_N recomputed from same final contact sample.

findings.title: Three-level mapping describes phase intervals but not measured skill predicates
findings.details: Mapping provides HL labels and low phase intervals, but does not attach checked preconditions/effects, entry/exit support/contact/velocity and required continuity outcomes.
findings.recommended_action: Bind intervals to the predeclared expert-plan contracts and retain measured predicate values/results; report label/coverage mapping separately from fully checked skill refinement.
findings.resolution: Independent semantic reviewer now checks measured per-phase and observed step_label subactions, joint continuity, actual contact/support transitions and context-sensitive high-level binding. Contract v7 is an immutable development/post-job-start audit revision, not prospectively predeclared acceptance; partial progress was visible. Actual per-run review pending; task verdict never altered.

findings.title: Generic full-witness validator permits omitted actuator/integrity evidence
findings.details: qpos/qvel are checked only for finite nonempty consistent length, controls only finite plus public_limits_pass boolean. No actual effort, frozen joint count/limits, substep coverage, pose-write/attachment/root-wrench monitoring is mandatory. A synthetic fixture without all such measurements returns witnessed_full.
findings.recommended_action: Require frozen physical joint identities/limits and physics cadence; validate interval actual position/velocity/effort extrema and integrity monitor artifacts. Keep explicit trusted-worker boundary.
findings.resolution: Mandatory frozen cadence/joint limits, per-control physics interval q/velocity/effort extrema and run integrity audit added. Four independent negative regressions return unknown. Still depends on trusted measurement adapter.

findings.title: Skill predicate pass flags are trusted declarations
findings.details: Segment entry_pass/effect_pass/constraints_pass are booleans rather than independently recomputed predicates. Endpoint identity and range coverage are checked, but physical skill satisfaction depends on the trusted recorder.
findings.recommended_action: Either implement task-specific numeric predicate validators or clearly label this part declaration/identity validation pending independent review; never claim general physical feasibility solving.
findings.resolution: Owner documented skill flags as trusted adapter declarations, unlike independently recomputed D/Q physical predicates. A task-specific adapter remains required.

findings.title: 20 mrad position allowance silently weakened original 1 mrad public actuator criterion
findings.resolution: Native checker restored original tolerance by GPU owner; independent semantic v8 does likewise. Original reports/source retained. No new successful physics claim.

findings.title: Original five safety rules absent from v2 evidence; root speed alone cannot exclude stationary fallen posture
findings.resolution: Independent adapter directly calls unchanged original safety modules. Native verifier now gates on complete safety review; v2 remains unknown. Recorder added exact foot geometry, all-object and cabinet contacts, signed measured actual torque for v3.

findings.title: V3 terminal hand clearance/stand produces sustained elbow limit pushing and transient foot unloading; one run also has finger/waist position violations
findings.repair_scope: Only planning/reference margins, slower final movement and bounded reference increments. Separate diagnostic never a full witness; full run must restart at original state.

synthetic_checks.interpretation: These results identify fail-open evidence schema gaps in the reviewed version. They do not imply actual GPU runs used illegal actions.
